annotations.title: Act on several rows from reports

description: Act on several rows from reports.delivery at once: request a new plan, approve each case's current saved plan and run it, or start an approved plan that is waiting. Returns done, skipped or failed with a reason for each row. Rows with no confirmed result are never run again. Approval binds to each case's exact saved plan and prepared changes; plans that changed or need a choice between options are skipped. request_plan needs investigations.request; the others need a person's delegated actions.approve.

action.description: request_plan asks the agent for a new plan. approve_and_run approves each case's current saved plan, bound to its exact prepared changes, then runs it. run_again starts an approved plan that is waiting to start.

authorization.description: The operator's instruction for this work, kept with each approval. Needed for approve_and_run and run_again. This is context, not an identity attestation.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change
